instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: HazardGate Entry Clearance reviews restricted-area entry requests using work-readiness, safety, and access information. Trade Forepersons identify the crew, work area, and planned activity; Site Supervisors record readiness; Safety Officers record hazards and controls; Access Marshals record access periods and briefing acknowledgements; and Permit Controllers decide after required information is present. The entry-start rule is disputed, while hazard categories, control-verification responsibility, and the decision deadline remain undecided. Performing construction work and emergency response are outside the project.

output.summary: HazardGate Entry Clearance reviews restricted-area entry requests using work-readiness, safety, and access information. Trade Forepersons provide request details, Site Supervisors record readiness, Safety Officers record hazards and controls, Access Marshals record access and briefing information, and Permit Controllers record decisions after required information is present. The entry-start rule remains disputed, while hazard categories, control-verification responsibility, and the decision deadline are undecided. Construction work and emergency response are outside the project.
output.primary_goal: Review restricted-area entry requests using work-readiness, safety, and access information.
key_capabilities: Submit restricted-area entry requests with crew, work-area, and planned-activity information.
Record identified hazards and required controls.
Record authorized access periods and crew-briefing acknowledgements.
Record approved or declined decisions after required information is present.
unresolved_points: Whether a crew may enter before Permit Controller approval.
Which role verifies that required controls are in place.
